_comment: Hand-written cases for the gate and trigger logic (runtime/SPEC.md §3). Both runtimes run these without any model. Expected values are worked out by hand in the comments.

trigger.name: 2-of-3 with refractory
trigger._why: refractory_ms 192 at hop 1536 = 2 ticks. t3: [T,F,T] fires, blocks t4-t5; t6 fires again, blocks t7-t8; t10: [F,T,T] fires.

trigger.name: 1-of-1 without refractory fires every tick above threshold
refractory rounds up to whole ticks
trigger._why: refractory_ms 100 = 1600 samples at 16 kHz -> ceil(1600 / 1536) = 2 ticks, so t1-t2 are blocked.

trigger.name: history keeps counting during refractory
trigger._why: Scores during refractory still enter the k-of-n history: t2 is blocked, t3 sees [T,T,F] and fires.

gate.name: open while a recent frame reached the threshold
gate._why: vad_hangover_ms 128 = 2048 samples = 4 frames; ticks every 3 frames. Tick spans (last 4 frames): t0 0-2, t1 2-5, t2 5-8, t3 8-11, t4 11-14.
